items.question: What does learning strategy consulting include?
items.answer: It covers your L&D operating model, capability and competency frameworks, curriculum architecture, learning measurement and governance, all aligned to the business plan.

items.question: How is a learning strategy different from a training plan?
items.answer: A training plan lists courses. A learning strategy defines the operating model, capability priorities and measurement that decide which courses matter and why, so spend follows business goals.

items.question: How long does a learning strategy engagement take?
items.answer: Typically four to eight weeks for the strategy and architecture, depending on organization size and how many roles are in scope.

items.question: Do you build the competency frameworks too?
items.answer: Yes. Role-based competency models and career pathways are a core deliverable, so capability is defined the same way across the business.

items.question: What do we get at the end?
items.answer: A business-aligned L&D strategy, a 12 to 24 month roadmap, competency frameworks, a curriculum blueprint and a measurement framework you own and run.
